errors.evidence: The figure is a pie chart, not a line chart as stated in the description.

The largest sector, representing 80.3%, corresponds to "Концесии за добив на подземни богатства" (Concessions for extraction of mineral resources), not "Концесии за услуги" (Concessions for services).

errors.text_span: „Концесии за добив на подземни богатства“, който отговаря за 14,6%
errors.evidence: The second largest sector, representing 14.6%, corresponds to "Концесии за морски плажове" (Concessions for sea beaches), not "Концесии за добив на подземни богатства".
The 14.6% sector is colored red, not light blue as described.
The sector for "Концесии за строителство" (Concessions for construction) represents 0.7%, not 2.2%.

This part of the sentence associates the color red with the "Концесии за строителство" category (which it incorrectly states is 2.2%). The red slice in the chart actually represents 14.6% and corresponds to "Концесии за морски плажове".
The smallest sector (0.7%) is for "Концесии за строителство" (Concessions for construction). The description provides an incorrect and truncated category name.
The smallest sector (0.7%) is light blue/teal, not bordeaux/maroon.

errors.evidence: The legend shows the category name and its corresponding color, but it does not include the percentage values. The percentages are labeled directly on the pie slices.
The legend is located below the chart, not next to it.
